FOREIGN AFFAIRS SECTION
CRIME & SPECIAL BRANCH Station. File No.................... Date 12 - 3 - 1943

SUBJECT:

RE MR. LEONID T. IVANOFF , AN APPLICANT FOR
A POSITION IN FILM CENSORING OFFICE .

With reference to report of 1 -3 - 1943
I beg to state , that inquiries show that
he is a reliable young man with sound poli-
tical views .

Although a Russian by birth , he is
actually a German by education . I understand
that he was to join the German army , and only
the outbreak of war in Russia prevented him
from going to Germany .

He is a member of all local German organisation
such as Deutsche Gemeinde ( German Community ) ,
Hitler Jugend ( Hitler Youth Organisation) and
is highly recommended by the leaders of these
organizations .

D.S.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
编号 U... 226
日期... ... 47

罪案与特务组 站。档案号.................... 日期 1943年3月12日

事由：

关于列昂尼德·T·伊万诺夫先生（MR. LEONID T. IVANOFF）申请电影审查办公室职位一事。

参照1943年3月1日的报告，
谨陈述如下：经调查，该人是一名政治观点端正、可靠的青年。

虽生于俄罗斯，但其实际受的是德国教育。据悉，他本欲加入德国军队，仅因俄国爆发战争而未能前往德国。

他是所有在沪德国组织的成员，如德意志社群（Deutsche Gemeinde，即 German Community）、希特勒青年团（Hitler Jugend，即 Hitler Youth Organisation），并得到这些组织领导人的高度推荐。

D.S.

外事科科长

（印：编入
特务组登记册
日期 1943年3月18日）

（批：抄
送泽田

RE APPLICATION OF MR L. IVANOFF FOR A POSITION
IN FILM CENSORING OFFICE ,CRIME & SPECIAL BRANCH.

Mr. Leonid Th. Ivanoff ,21 years of age
residing at 131/25 Route Seysoung , Tel. 78585 ,
He is aRussian , born in Shanghai in 1921 .
His father Theodore J. Ivanoff,a retired employee
of Chinese Maritime Customs is living now in
Shanghai at the same address as the applicant .
His father in the course of his sevice was
transferred to Harbin(1924 - 1927) , then
to Shanghai again ( 1927 - 1930 ) ; Hankow ( 1930
- 1934 ) , in 1934 he visited during his long
leave Germany and after that till his retirement
in 1939 he lived in Shanghai . The applicant
lived all this time with his parents . He received
his education in German schools in Harbin ,
Hankow and Shanghai German schools . He is
a graduate of Kaiser Wilhelm's Schule in Shanghai.
After his graduation he joined Siemens -China
as an apprentice in the year of his graduation1940
He is well recommended and posseses the
knowledge of the following languages : Russian,
German , English , Latvian , and French

............................
D.3.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs Sect.

1943年3月1日

关于 L. 伊万诺夫先生申请罪案与特务组电影审查办公室职位一事。

列昂尼德·西奥多罗维奇·伊万诺夫先生（Mr. Leonid Th. Ivanoff），21岁，
居住于西摩路131/25号，电话 78585，
系俄罗斯人，1921年生于上海。
其父西奥多·J·伊万诺夫（Theodore J. Ivanoff），系中国海关退休职员，现居上海，地址与申请人相同。
其父在职期间曾调任哈尔滨（1924 - 1927），后
又调回上海（1927 - 1930）；汉口（1930
- 1934），1934年他在长期休假期间访问了
德国，此后直至1939年退休一直居住在上海。申请人
在此期间一直与父母同住。他在哈尔滨、
汉口和上海的德国学校接受教育。他是
上海威廉皇帝学校（Kaiser Wilhelm's Schule）的毕业生。
毕业后，他于毕业同年1940年
以学徒身份加入西门子-中国公司（Siemens -China）。
他获得良好推荐，并掌握以下
语言：俄语、
德语、英语、拉脱维亚语和法语

............................
D.3.

........................................
外事科科长
